title: Primary Care Provider Assignment: No-Cost Second Opinions
content:
**Member handbook benefit statement — second opinions under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

### The benefit

A member may obtain a second opinion from another in-network specialist at no cost; the member's own request is recorded as a second-opinion referral from the member's active assignment to the specialist the member chose, and it records the visits the second opinion covers.

### When a second-opinion referral is recorded

A second-opinion referral is recorded only after the current assignment carries a single referral, dated on or after the assignment's effective date, to the specialist whose recommendation is being reviewed.

Where the recommendation under review is a surgery, the specialist whose recommendation is being reviewed is the requesting provider on the member's Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization request.

| In the current assignment's referral history | Second-opinion referral |
|---|---|
| A single referral to the specialist whose recommendation is being reviewed, dated on or after the assignment's effective date | Can be recorded |
| A single referral to that specialist dated before the assignment's effective date only | Not yet recorded |
| No single referral to that specialist | Not yet recorded |

### Member request entry: `request_second_opinion_76735634`

**Capability.** The member requests, in person, a no-cost second opinion from an in-network specialist of the member's own choosing. One call records the member's request as one second-opinion referral entry, dated today and given a new referral number, on the member's active primary care assignment, naming the chosen specialist and the number of visits the second opinion covers. Nothing else on the member's record changes; the member receives the referral number to give the chosen specialist's office when booking.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the representative unlocks `request_second_opinion_76735634` with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the member — runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pcp_assignment_id` | Reference number of the member's active primary care assignment | As the representative reads it from the member's primary care assignment record and gives it to the member |
| `specialist_npi` | NPI of the specialist the member chose for the second opinion | 10-digit NPI, digits only, no spaces or punctuation |
| `referral_visits` | Number of visits the second opinion covers | Whole number of at least one visit, no decimals |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (the text "requested" when the request was recorded), `pcp_event_id` (reference of the new referral history entry), `referral_number` (the second-opinion referral number in the form RF-YYMM-NNNNN), `specialist_npi` (10-digit NPI of the chosen specialist), `request_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `referral_visits` (integer visits recorded). A receipt with status "requested" means the second opinion is authorised on the assignment.
